company.name: Harborwick 3PL Ltd.
company.summary: Fictional 3PL/distribution warehouse: 6,000 m2, about 40 staff, two shifts, six zones A-F, electric MHE fleet.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklifts must not exceed 8 km/h inside the building.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklifts must not exceed 15 km/h in the outdoor yard.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklifts must slow to 5 km/h in marked pedestrian zones and crossings.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklifts must not exceed 5 km/h on dock ramps and leveller approaches.

facts.subject: pallet_stack
facts.statement: Free block-stacked pallets must not exceed 4.0 m in height.

facts.subject: pallet_stack
facts.statement: Free block-stacked pallets must not exceed 3 pallets high.

facts.subject: rack_bay
facts.statement: Each rack bay may carry at most 2,700 kg.

facts.subject: cold_zone
facts.statement: The cold zone must stay at or above +2 °C.

facts.subject: cold_zone
facts.statement: The cold zone must stay at or below +8 °C.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: No more than 4,000 kg of hazmat may be stored in the hazmat cage at one time.

facts.subject: main_aisle
facts.statement: Main transport aisles are 4.0 m wide.

facts.subject: storage_aisle
facts.statement: Rack storage aisles are 3.0 m wide.

facts.subject: pedestrian_walkway
facts.statement: Segregated pedestrian walkways are 1.2 m wide.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: Damaged-goods write-offs above 750 EUR need warehouse-manager approval.

facts.subject: zone_a
facts.statement: Zone A is the receiving zone: inbound docks 1-4, unloading and goods inspection.

facts.subject: zone_b
facts.statement: Zone B is the bulk storage zone: high-bay pallet racking.

facts.subject: zone_c
facts.statement: Zone C is the picking zone: ground-level pick faces and flow racks.

facts.subject: zone_d
facts.statement: Zone D is the dispatch zone: outbound staging in front of docks 5-8.

facts.subject: zone_e
facts.statement: Zone E is the cold zone: chilled storage held at +2 to +8 °C.

facts.subject: zone_f
facts.statement: Zone F holds the value-added services area.

facts.subject: warehouse
facts.statement: The warehouse floor covers 6,000 m2.

facts.subject: racking
facts.statement: The high-bay racking provides 2,400 pallet positions.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: The building has 8 dock doors.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: Dock doors 1-4 serve inbound receiving.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: Dock doors 5-8 serve outbound dispatch.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage inside Zone F covers 60 m2.

facts.subject: quarantine_area
facts.statement: The quarantine area is in Zone F.

facts.subject: returns_inspection
facts.statement: Returns are inspected in Zone F.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage is inside Zone F.

facts.subject: warehouse_manager
facts.value: Accountable for the whole site: operations, safety and final sign-offs.
facts.statement: The warehouse manager is accountable for the whole site: operations, safety and final sign-offs.

facts.subject: shift_supervisor
facts.value: Runs one shift: floor staff and incident response.
facts.statement: The shift supervisor runs one shift: floor staff and incident response.

facts.subject: forklift_operator
facts.value: Operates forklifts, reach trucks and pallet jacks.
facts.statement: Forklift operators operate forklifts, reach trucks and pallet jacks.

facts.subject: picker
facts.value: Picks customer orders in Zone C against scanner tasks.
facts.statement: Pickers pick customer orders in Zone C against scanner tasks.

facts.subject: inbound_operator
facts.value: Unloads, counts and inspects inbound goods in Zone A.
facts.statement: Inbound operators unload, count and inspect inbound goods in Zone A.

facts.subject: stock_controller
facts.value: Owns inventory accuracy: cycle counts, recounts and adjustments.
facts.statement: Stock controllers own inventory accuracy: cycle counts, recounts and adjustments.

facts.subject: returns_staff
facts.value: Inspects returns in Zone F and proposes restock, rework or scrap.
facts.statement: Returns staff inspect returns in Zone F and propose restock, rework or scrap.

facts.subject: maintenance_technician
facts.value: Maintains MHE, racking and dock equipment and logs all repairs.
facts.statement: The maintenance technician maintains MHE, racking and dock equipment and logs all repairs.

facts.subject: dispatcher
facts.value: Books transport, assigns dock doors and releases outbound loads.
facts.statement: Dispatchers book transport, assign dock doors and release outbound loads.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.statement: Only the warehouse manager may sign off stocktake results.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: The shift supervisor approves damaged-goods write-offs up to 500 EUR.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: The warehouse manager approves damaged-goods write-offs above 500 EUR.

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: The shift supervisor approves the final disposition of inspected returns.

facts.subject: overtime
facts.statement: Only the warehouse manager may approve overtime.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: The dispatcher assigns dock doors and time slots to carriers.

facts.subject: incidents
facts.statement: The shift supervisor reviews every incident report.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Only the warehouse manager may authorise new forklift operators.

facts.subject: procedure

facts.subject: procedure

facts.subject: procedure

facts.subject: ppe
facts.statement: High-visibility vests are mandatory for everyone on the warehouse floor.

facts.subject: ppe
facts.statement: Safety footwear class S3 is mandatory on the warehouse floor.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Forklift operators must wear seat belts whenever the truck is moving.

facts.subject: receiving
facts.statement: At receiving, the document check happens BEFORE unloading (PR-01).

facts.subject: receiving
facts.statement: Inbound goods are inspected BEFORE they are booked into the system (PR-01).

facts.subject: putaway
facts.statement: Goods are booked into the system BEFORE put-away to storage (PR-02).

facts.subject: picking
facts.statement: Pick faces are replenished BEFORE the picking shift starts (PR-03).

facts.subject: packing
facts.statement: Picked items are scan-verified BEFORE packing (PR-04, PR-05).

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: Returns are inspected BEFORE any restock, rework or scrap decision (PR-07).

facts.subject: stocktaking
facts.statement: A second count happens BEFORE any stock adjustment is posted (PR-08).

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: The daily forklift check happens BEFORE first use each day (PR-10).

facts.subject: evacuation
facts.statement: Roll call at the assembly point happens BEFORE anyone re-enters the building (PR-14).

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: The fleet has 6 electric counterbalance forklifts.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Counterbalance forklifts are rated at 2.5 t.

facts.subject: reach_truck
facts.statement: The fleet has 4 reach trucks for the high bays.

facts.subject: reach_truck
facts.statement: Reach trucks are rated at 1.6 t.

facts.subject: pallet_jack
facts.statement: The fleet has 8 electric pallet jacks.

facts.subject: pallet_jack
facts.statement: The site has 12 hand pallet jacks.

facts.subject: wrapper
facts.statement: Dispatch uses 2 semi-automatic stretch wrappers.

facts.subject: baler
facts.statement: The site has 1 cardboard baler.

facts.subject: dock
facts.statement: Each of the 8 dock doors has a dock leveller.

facts.subject: scanner
facts.statement: Pickers and inbound staff share 20 handheld WMS scanners.

facts.subject: shift_1
facts.statement: Shift 1 runs 06:00-14:00, Monday to Friday.

facts.subject: shift_2
facts.statement: Shift 2 runs 14:00-22:00, Monday to Friday.

facts.subject: cycle_count
facts.statement: Cycle counts run every working day on a rotating zone schedule.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.statement: A full wall-to-wall stocktake runs once a year.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.statement: Every forklift gets a documented pre-use check each day.

facts.subject: racking
facts.statement: Racking gets a documented safety inspection every month.

facts.subject: evacuation
facts.statement: An evacuation drill runs every quarter.

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: Returns are accepted within 14 days of delivery.

facts.subject: cold_zone
facts.statement: Cold-zone temperature is manually verified each shift.

facts.subject: pallet
facts.statement: A pallet, including its load, may weigh at most 800 kg.

facts.subject: trailer
facts.statement: Our contracted curtain-side trailers carry a payload of 22000 kg.

facts.subject: trailer
facts.statement: A trailer has 33 floor pallet positions.

facts.subject: van
facts.statement: Our delivery van carries a payload of 1200 kg.

facts.subject: van
facts.statement: The delivery van has 6 pallet positions.

facts.subject: outbound_door
facts.statement: Each outbound door handles 4 trailer loads per shift.

facts.subject: docks
facts.statement: There are 4 outbound dock doors.

facts.subject: trailer
facts.statement: A trailer takes at most 27 full-weight pallets (payload divided by maximum pallet weight, capped by floor positions).

facts.subject: van
facts.statement: The van takes at most 1 full-weight pallets; heavier orders go by trailer.

facts.subject: dispatch
facts.statement: Outbound capacity is at most 432 full-weight pallets per shift (doors x loads per shift x pallets per trailer).

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage holds at most 5 full-weight pallets (hazmat stock limit divided by maximum pallet weight).

facts.subject: packing_rework
facts.statement: Packing rework is carried out in Zone F.

facts.subject: labelling
facts.statement: Labelling is carried out in Zone F.

facts.subject: kitting
facts.statement: Kitting is carried out in Zone F.

facts.subject: unloading_equipment
facts.statement: Unloading equipment is staged along the Zone A wall.

facts.subject: temperature_affected_stock
facts.statement: Pallets found outside permitted temperature range are moved to quarantine in Zone F for assessment.

facts.subject: pallet_transfer
facts.value: Zone A -> Zone B -> Zone C -> Zone D
facts.statement: Pallets transfer from Zone A to Zone B to Zone C to Zone D.

facts.subject: leveller
facts.value: vehicle braked, chocked and stationary, then deploy leveller
facts.statement: The dock leveller must be deployed only after the vehicle is braked, chocked and confirmed stationary at the door.

facts.subject: leveller
facts.value: check, then position and extend lip, then confirm seating
facts.statement: Dock levellers must be operated in order: check for damage or obstruction, then position and extend the lip, then confirm stable seating before movements.

facts.subject: cycle_count
facts.value: Zone B, Zone C, Zone E, Zone F quarantine area
facts.statement: Cycle counts are performed across Zone B racking, Zone C pick faces, Zone E and the Zone F quarantine area.

facts.subject: returns_restock
facts.statement: Restocked returns are placed in Zone B or Zone C.

facts.subject: inbound_exceptions
facts.statement: Inbound exceptions are segregated for stock-controller review.

facts.subject: weekly_roster
facts.statement: The weekly roster must be published before the working week starts.

facts.subject: shift_handover
facts.statement: Shift handover between Shift 1 and Shift 2 occurs at 14:00 every working day.

facts.subject: shift_supervisor
facts.statement: One shift supervisor is assigned to each shift.

facts.subject: shift_handover
facts.statement: The outgoing shift supervisor must brief the incoming shift supervisor face to face and sign the handover record.

facts.subject: shift_handover
facts.statement: The floor walk to confirm the state of receiving, storage, picking and dispatch areas must happen before the handover meeting.

facts.subject: shift_handover
facts.statement: The floor must never be left unattended during the handover discussion.

facts.subject: handover_record
facts.statement: Both outgoing and incoming shift supervisors must jointly sign the handover record only when both accept the stated floor position.

facts.subject: cycle_count
facts.value: count closed, then put-away and picking
facts.statement: Counted locations must remain clear of put-away and picking until the count is closed.

facts.subject: inbound_exceptions
facts.value: stock-controller review, then booking or put-away
facts.statement: Inbound exceptions must be held for stock-controller review before booking or put-away.

facts.subject: nonconforming_goods
facts.statement: Non-conforming inbound goods must be segregated within Zone A.

facts.subject: receiving
facts.statement: At receiving, unloading happens BEFORE inspection.

facts.subject: inbound_labelling
facts.value: scan verification, then move from inspection area
facts.statement: Each inbound label must be scan-verified against the system receipt before the unit is moved from the inspection area.

facts.subject: heavy_pallet
facts.statement: Heavy pallets must be distributed to lower beam levels and not concentrated beyond bay rating.

facts.subject: block_stacking
facts.value: only where racking unavailable and system directs
facts.statement: Free block stacking is allowed only where racking locations are not available and the system explicitly directs block stacking.

facts.subject: damaged_pallet
facts.statement: Damaged pallets, collapsed loads or overweight units must be returned to the inspection area for reassessment.

facts.subject: racking_damage
facts.statement: Any upright damage, beam deformation, missing safety pins or anchor failure observed during put-away must be notified to the maintenance technician at once.

facts.subject: damaged_rack_bay
facts.statement: No further put-away to a damaged or overloaded bay is allowed until the bay is cleared and released.

facts.subject: chilled_product
facts.statement: All chilled product requiring controlled refrigeration must be stored in Zone E.

facts.subject: chilled_pallet
facts.value: inbound inspection area directly to Zone E, no ambient staging
facts.statement: Chilled pallets must transfer directly between the inbound inspection area and Zone E without staging in ambient areas.

facts.subject: chilled_pallet
facts.value: Zone E directly to dispatch staging area
facts.statement: Outbound chilled pallets must move directly from Zone E to the dispatch staging area for prompt loading.

facts.subject: zone_e
facts.value: put-away, replenishment, picking, stock counting or supervision personnel only
facts.statement: Entry to Zone E is restricted to personnel engaged in put-away, replenishment, picking, stock counting or supervision of those tasks.

facts.subject: zone_e_stock
facts.value: incoming behind existing, earliest expiry first
facts.statement: In Zone E incoming batches must be placed behind existing stock and the earliest expiry picked first unless the system directs otherwise.

facts.subject: temperature_affected_stock
facts.value: assessment, then return to Zone E or release for picking
facts.statement: Pallets found outside the permitted temperature range must complete assessment before return to Zone E or release for picking.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The hazmat cage must be inspected each shift for leaks, damaged packaging, missing labels and blocked access.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: The running cage weight total must be verified before transporting any additional pallet to the hazmat cage.

facts.subject: quarantine_stock
facts.statement: Quarantined pallets may be moved out only after authorised assessment releases them to their system-directed destination.

facts.subject: hazmat_overflow
facts.statement: Hazmat overflow must never be stored in the quarantine area.

facts.subject: quarantined_general_stock
facts.statement: Quarantined general stock must never be stored inside the hazmat cage.

facts.subject: replenishment
facts.statement: Replenishment reserve stock must be drawn only from Zone B.

facts.subject: replenishment
facts.statement: Replenishment must be delivered only to Zone C pick faces and flow-rack lanes.

facts.subject: excess_stock
facts.statement: Excess or mis-directed stock must be returned to its Zone B reserve location and not staged in picking aisles.

facts.subject: replenishment
facts.statement: Replenishment scan verification must occur at source removal before destination placement.

facts.subject: replenishment
facts.value: urgent and short first, then remaining scheduled
facts.statement: Urgent and short pick faces must be replenished before remaining scheduled top-ups.

facts.subject: picking
facts.value: source location label, then item or carton
facts.statement: In Zone C picking, the source location label must be scanned before scanning each picked item or carton.

facts.subject: scanner_shortage
facts.statement: Any scanner shortage or fault must be reported to the shift supervisor immediately.

facts.subject: scanner
facts.statement: Handheld WMS scanners are collected from and returned to the charging station for charging.

facts.subject: completed_totes
facts.statement: Completed scan-verified totes must be left in the marked collection point.

facts.subject: picking_waste
facts.statement: Picking waste such as stretch film, strapping and empty cartons must be removed to waste cages.

facts.subject: packing
facts.statement: Packing under PR-05 is executed in Zone D before transfer to loading.

facts.subject: stretch_wrapper
facts.statement: Outbound pallet stretch wrappers are located in dispatch in Zone D.

facts.subject: handling_unit
facts.statement: Each handling unit carries one principal label.

facts.subject: packing
facts.statement: Label data must be confirmed against the outbound load record before sealing.

facts.subject: outbound_pallet
facts.statement: Outbound pallets must be wrapped before staging in Zone D.

facts.subject: staging_lane
facts.value: system recording before release for loading
facts.statement: Packed units, labels and wrapped pallets must be recorded in the system before releasing the staging lane for loading.

facts.subject: outbound_load
facts.value: dispatcher release, then move to door
facts.statement: A staging lane may be moved to a door only after the dispatcher has released that outbound load in the system.

facts.subject: loading_exception
facts.statement: Any scan mismatch, short pallet or damaged wrapping during loading must be notified to the dispatcher and loading stopped.

facts.subject: outbound_load
facts.statement: Pallets must never be substituted from another lane to complete an outbound load.

facts.subject: evacuation_resumption
facts.value: re-verify door, vehicle and count, then continue
facts.statement: After authorised re-entry following evacuation, the open door, vehicle position and staged count must be re-verified before continuing loading.

facts.subject: defective_equipment
facts.statement: Defective MHE must be parked in the designated quarantine line.

facts.subject: electric_truck
facts.statement: Electric trucks must be charged only in designated charging positions.

facts.subject: truck
facts.statement: Only the maintenance technician may return a truck with overdue planned maintenance to use.

facts.subject: reach_truck
facts.statement: Each reach truck requires a documented pre-use check each day.

facts.subject: electric_pallet_jack
facts.statement: Each electric pallet jack requires a documented pre-use check each day.

facts.subject: forklift
facts.value: prohibited in rack storage aisle, dock ramp and leveller approach, marked pedestrian zone
facts.statement: Trucks must never overtake another truck in a rack storage aisle, on a dock ramp or leveller approach, or in a marked pedestrian zone.

facts.subject: wrapper
facts.statement: Wrapper turntable, film carriage and controls must be checked for damage or film breaks before starting each wrapping run.

facts.subject: wrapper_fault
facts.statement: Unusual wrapper noise, uneven wrapping or control failure must be notified to the maintenance technician after isolating the wrapper.

facts.subject: baler
facts.statement: Each baler bale must be tied off before ejection after a full compression cycle.

facts.subject: finished_bale
facts.value: clear of wrapper lanes, staging lanes and dock approaches
facts.statement: Finished bales must be stored clear of wrapper lanes, staging lanes and dock approaches until collection.

facts.subject: dock_leveller
facts.value: return to stored position and close door after vehicle departs
facts.statement: Each dock leveller must be returned to its stored position and the dock door closed immediately after the vehicle departs.

facts.subject: dock_leveller_defect
facts.statement: Bent leveller lips, sticking decks, oil leaks, missing edge guards or obstructed pits must be reported to the maintenance technician.

facts.subject: walkway_defect
facts.statement: Faded walkway lines, damaged barriers, blocked crossings or obscured signage must be reported to the shift supervisor.

facts.subject: pedestrian_crossing
facts.value: Stop, look and eye contact, then step out
facts.statement: At marked crossings pedestrians must stop at the edge, look both ways and make eye contact before stepping out.

facts.subject: visitor_briefing
facts.statement: Visitors and new starters must be briefed on PR-11 before entering the floor.

facts.subject: seat_belt
facts.statement: A cut, frayed, jammed or non-latching forklift seat belt must be notified to the maintenance technician.

facts.subject: spare_ppe
facts.statement: Spare compliant vests and footwear are held at the charging station area.

facts.subject: cycle_count
facts.value: location label, then item or carton
facts.statement: Cycle counts must scan the location label first, then scan every item or carton in that location.

facts.subject: cycle_count
facts.value: direct scanner entry, no paper transcription unless system unavailable and fallback authorised
facts.statement: First counts must be entered directly into the scanner with no paper transcription unless the system is unavailable and the fallback is authorised.

facts.subject: stock_adjustment
facts.value: reason code, both count quantities, scanner identity and operator identity
facts.statement: Each posted stock adjustment must record the reason code, both count quantities, scanner identity and operator identity.

facts.subject: unresolved_variance
facts.statement: Unresolved count variances must be carried forward to the next working day.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.value: sign-off or authorised partial release, then release
facts.statement: Frozen zones must be released only after stocktake sign-off or authorised partial release.

facts.subject: stocktake
facts.value: system reflects approved adjustments, then restart booking, put-away and picking
facts.statement: The system must reflect approved adjustments before restarting inbound booking, put-away and order picking.

facts.subject: damaged_stock
facts.value: PR-09 assessment before stock adjustment posting
facts.statement: Every adjustment arising from damage must complete PR-09 Damaged-goods handling assessment before posting against inventory.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.value: write-off approval before stock adjustment posting
facts.statement: Damaged-goods write-off approval must be obtained before posting the corresponding stock adjustment.

facts.subject: damaged_goods
facts.statement: A single damage event must not be split into smaller values to remain below the approval threshold.

facts.subject: overloaded_bay
facts.statement: Where recounts confirm overstock above bay limits, the load must be redistributed before posting the adjustment.

facts.subject: returns_receipt
facts.value: verify delivery date, customer reference and reason code before moving goods inward
facts.statement: Authorised returns must have delivery date, customer reference and reason code verified against the system record before moving the goods inward.

facts.subject: returns_rework
facts.statement: Approved rework units must be transferred to the designated rework holding position inside Zone F.

facts.subject: returns_disposition
facts.value: shift-supervisor approval before restock, rework or scrap execution
facts.statement: No restock, rework or scrap of inspected returns may proceed without prior shift-supervisor approval of the disposition.

facts.subject: rework
facts.statement: Rework is carried out in Zone F.

facts.subject: returns_value_added
facts.statement: Returns must be inspected in Zone F under PR-07 before any unit is released to value-added work.

facts.subject: packing_rework
facts.statement: Packing rework in Zone F may be carried out only against a system task or supervisor instruction.

facts.subject: damaged_component
facts.statement: Components found damaged during rework must complete PR-09 assessment before further use.

facts.subject: excess_components
facts.statement: Excess components and unused packaging must be returned to system-directed locations and never staged in picking aisles.

facts.subject: temperature_record
facts.statement: The shift supervisor must review each shift cold-zone temperature record and investigate any deviation.

facts.subject: backup_monitoring_devices
facts.statement: Backup cold-zone monitoring devices are held available at the charging station area.

facts.subject: zone_e
facts.value: suspend replenishment and picking during recovery
facts.statement: Routine replenishment and picking in Zone E must be suspended while temperature recovery is in progress after a verified excursion.

facts.subject: temperature_recovery
facts.statement: Restoration of the +2 to +8 C condition must be confirmed through successive stable readings before resuming normal chilled operations.

facts.subject: evacuation
facts.statement: Missing persons, last known location and nature of the emergency must be reported to the shift supervisor at the assembly point.

facts.subject: truck_securing
facts.value: lower forks, apply parking brake and switch off, then leave
facts.statement: Before leaving a truck during evacuation forks must be lowered fully, parking brake applied and truck switched off.

facts.subject: re_entry
facts.value: all-clear and confirmed safe condition, then authorise re-entry
facts.statement: Re-entry may be authorised only after the all-clear and confirmed safe condition of the building.

facts.subject: corrective_actions
facts.statement: Agreed corrections to signage, routes, lighting or briefing must be implemented before the next working day.

facts.subject: drill_log
facts.statement: Each drill log entry must record drill date, evacuation time, attendance and deficiencies.

facts.subject: reach_truck
facts.statement: Each reach truck requires a documented pre-use check before first use each day.

facts.subject: electric_pallet_jack
facts.statement: Each electric pallet jack requires a documented pre-use check before first use each day.

facts.subject: daily_check
facts.value: record in log, then move truck
facts.statement: Each daily truck check must be recorded in the designated log before moving the truck.

facts.subject: truck_defect
facts.statement: Every defect found during truck checks or operation must be notified to the maintenance technician.

facts.subject: handling_equipment
facts.value: outside Zone E unless actively loading or unloading
facts.statement: Handling equipment must be parked outside Zone E unless actively loading or unloading.

facts.subject: cold_zone_temperature_verification
facts.value: reading, measuring device identity and time of check
facts.statement: Each cold-zone temperature verification must record the reading, the measuring device identity and the time of check.

facts.subject: cold_zone_doors
facts.value: closed immediately after each movement, never wedged open
facts.statement: Cold-zone doors must be closed immediately after each pallet or personnel movement and never wedged open.

facts.subject: putaway
facts.statement: Put-away requires verification of the system-directed location before lifting any pallet to height.

facts.subject: rack_bay
facts.statement: A damaged or overloaded rack bay must be cleared and released by the maintenance technician before reloading.

facts.subject: hazmat_storage
facts.statement: All hazardous materials must be stored only in the hazmat cage inside Zone F.

facts.subject: running_total
facts.statement: The visible running weight total must be maintained at the cage entrance.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.value: trained personnel assigned to hazmat task only
facts.statement: Entry to the hazmat cage is allowed only to trained personnel assigned to the hazmat task.

facts.subject: hazmat_transport
facts.statement: Hazmat pallets must be transported one at a time.

facts.subject: new_hazmat_line
facts.statement: The warehouse manager must give prior approval before accepting any new hazmat line or increased stock.

facts.subject: hazmat_cage
facts.statement: Cage stock weight, pallet count and documentation must be audited daily.

facts.subject: running_total
facts.statement: The running total must be updated immediately after each placement and each removal.

facts.subject: spill
facts.statement: Any leak, spill or damaged container must be notified to the shift supervisor without delay.

facts.subject: damage_dispute
facts.statement: Any dispute over damaged-goods value or responsibility must be escalated to the shift supervisor for decision.

facts.subject: spill_damage_event
facts.statement: Every spill and damage event must be reviewed at shift handover.

facts.subject: quarantine_records
facts.statement: All open quarantine records must be closed before the next shift starts.

facts.subject: incident_report
facts.value: time, exact location, persons involved, equipment involved, description
facts.statement: Each incident report must provide the time, exact location, persons involved, equipment involved and a brief description of what happened.

facts.subject: incident_report
facts.value: before end of shift in designated incident log
facts.statement: The initial incident report must be recorded in the designated incident log before the end of the shift in which the event occurred.

facts.subject: roll_call
facts.statement: The shift supervisor conducts roll call of all floor staff, visitors and contractors at the assembly point.

facts.subject: emergency_services
facts.statement: Liaison with the emergency services must go only through the shift supervisor or the warehouse manager.

facts.subject: post_evacuation_work
facts.statement: Work may resume after re-entry only when instructed by the shift supervisor.

facts.subject: defective_equipment
facts.statement: Defective equipment must stay isolated from service until the maintenance technician clears it for return to use.

facts.subject: transport_arrival_window
facts.statement: The dispatcher communicates arrival windows to carriers and the floor team.

facts.subject: dispatcher_handover
facts.statement: The outgoing dispatcher briefs the incoming dispatcher on open loads for handover.

facts.subject: carrier_arrival
facts.statement: All carrier arrivals require a pre-booked slot.

facts.subject: inbound_vehicle
facts.statement: Booked inbound vehicles received within published receiving hours must complete document check, unloading, inspection and system booking on the day of arrival.

facts.subject: inbound_exception
facts.statement: The carrier is notified when inspection identifies shortage, damage or documentation mismatch.

facts.subject: carrier_loading
facts.statement: Carriers must be loaded only against the dispatcher-assigned dock door and time slot.

facts.subject: order_preparation
facts.statement: All orders are prepared under PR-05 Packing and labelling before handover to PR-06 Outbound dispatch for staging and loading.

facts.subject: unreleased_load
facts.value: rebook to next available door and slot
facts.statement: Loads not released by the dispatcher-confirmed cut-off time for the booked slot are rebooked to the next available door and slot.

facts.subject: rebooked_load
facts.statement: The client is notified of the revised departure when a load is rebooked to a new door and slot.

facts.subject: replenishment_shortfall
facts.statement: Replenishment shortfalls affecting wave start must be notified to the client record.

facts.subject: picking
facts.value: live system tasks only, no paper substitute where available
facts.statement: PR-04 order picking must be executed only against live system tasks on handheld devices with no paper-based substitute picking where system tasks are available.

facts.subject: picking
facts.statement: Each pick must be scan-verified at the pick face before tote transfer.

facts.subject: capacity_allocation
facts.statement: Bulk and picking balances across the 2,400 pallet positions are reviewed on each working day.

facts.subject: stocktake_plan
facts.statement: The warehouse manager approves the annual stocktake plan.

facts.subject: stocktake_reconciliation
facts.value: opening position, counts, adjustments and closing position
facts.statement: The post-stocktake client reconciliation must show opening position, counts, adjustments and closing position.

facts.subject: cycle_count_report
facts.value: locations counted, hit rate and open variances
facts.statement: The client cycle-count report must include locations counted, hit rate and open variances.

facts.subject: damaged_stock
facts.statement: Damaged, suspect and non-conforming stock must be segregated to quarantine on the day of discovery.

facts.subject: quarantine_status
facts.statement: Quarantine status forms part of daily operational reporting.

facts.subject: quarantine_holdings
facts.statement: All quarantine holdings in Zone F are reconciled against incident reports and write-off approvals at month end.

facts.subject: quarantine_assessment
facts.value: photographic evidence, quantity, value and cause
facts.statement: Each PR-09 quarantine assessment must retain photographic evidence, quantity, value and cause against the client stock record.

facts.subject: returns
facts.statement: Requests after the 14-day returns window require prior written exception agreement by the client before goods are returned to site.

facts.subject: zone_e_monitoring
facts.statement: Zone E operates continuous monitoring with automated alerting for excursion risk.

facts.subject: excursion_response
facts.statement: The shift supervisor initiates the PR-12 excursion response when a deviation from +2 to +8 C is indicated.

facts.subject: temperature_excursion
facts.statement: Clients receive notification of any verified excursion affecting their stock.
